concepts.def: Mao Zedong declared People's Republic on 1 October from Tiananmen Gate after Communist victory over Chiang Kai-shek's KMT.
Mao's invitation to criticise the Party; followed by Anti-Rightist Campaign purging 550,000 intellectuals.
Mao's industrialisation campaign through communes and backyard furnaces; caused famine killing 15-45 million.
Mao's purge of 'Four Olds'; Red Guards attacked teachers, intellectuals, Party rivals; closed schools and universities.
Ideological breach from 1960; Khrushchev withdrew advisers, border clashes at Ussuri River 1969; opened door for Nixon's 1972 visit.
PLA crackdown on student democracy protests on 4 June; tanks and live fire killed hundreds to thousands.
